node.title: Rate-half MCA deployed pole-line typed witness certificate
node.closure: pinned upstream certificate plus independent reconstruction
node.statement: The upstream #1159 record KB_SPARSE_BOUNDARY_ACTUAL_RECORD_V1 is a typed, machine-checked actual deployed KoalaBear MCA witness. On the exact size-m support, the pole line at slope alpha reduces to indicator_E and is explained by zero, while the direction word cannot agree with any degree-<k polynomial there. Its support-complement locator and zero numerator pass the degree-guarded shifted-lattice adapter. The received-word lattice minimum is exactly 67473 under both shifts, giving a boundary numerical profile for K=k and first-interior numerical profile for K=k+1. No frozen Q, BC, or U_new owner is assigned.
